schema_description: Directory-level resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar. Covers all per-cell evaluation.json files under results/h12-v2/greedy/**/ and results/h12-v2/wbf/**/ produced by scripts/evaluate_detections.py. Does NOT cover the permutation-* subtrees (explicit metadata per registry).
registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20. Generated during the H12-v2 sweep on 2026-04-15.

invocation.command_shape: python scripts/evaluate_detections.py --detections <h12-v2 cell geojson> --buffers 20 30 40 50 --bootstrap 1000 --seed 42 --ground-truth <gold-standard v2 geojson> --bounds <standard 384 bounds>

per_cell_ci_count: 3 metrics (F1, precision, recall) x 4 buffers = 12 CIs per cell
notes: Hypothesis 12 v2 ratio regimes: r1-hn-heavy, r2-balanced, r3-hp-heavy. Greedy cells at thresholds t1..t5; WBF at default.
